properties.statement: Wrote ad-hoc scripts over the committed export, five separate times in one session, to answer one recurring question: "how many of my declared X carry a Y?" — how many Interfaces have an incoming VERIFIES, how many Capabilities carry a signature, how many Components sit at a given level and where they hang on the containment spine, how many nodes of a type have an edge of a type. Each answer took a fresh throwaway script. `find_tools` on "count edges of one type pointing at nodes of another type" returns a node lister and two bulk writers; the read has no served form. The counts these produced were the session's most load-bearing findings, so the shape is not incidental.
